operators.name: group_norm_forward
semantics: Computes Group Normalization as described in torch.nn.GroupNorm.
Input tensor x has shape (N, C, *spatial) with num_groups groups dividing C channels.
For each group, compute mean and variance over the channels in the group and all spatial dimensions.
Normalize: (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) * weight[c] + bias[c], where c is the channel index within the group.
GroupNorm with affine=True uses weight and bias parameters of shape (C,).
The output has same shape, dtype, device as x.
Works with arbitrary strides; internally may call contiguous if needed, but output must have same strides as input (contiguous output is acceptable).
Calls group_norm_forward(x, self.group_norm.weight, self.group_norm.bias, self.group_norm.num_groups, self.group_norm.eps).
Output is the result of group normalization.
Returns the normalized tensor from step_001.
